text: 从我身边的观察来看，四十岁是大部分普通人的分水岭。
en: From what I have observed around me, forty is the watershed for most ordinary people.

text: 大部分人的基本面在四十岁之前就完成了，后面只是添砖加瓦垒多高多低而已。
en: For most people, the fundamentals are settled before the age of forty; what follows is merely adding bricks and tiles, building higher or lower.

text: 不管是打工还是做老板的，大概率的都是这个节点。
en: Whether they are employees or bosses, most of them hit this point.

text: 当然，小概率的什么样的模板都有。
en: Of course, there are all sorts of outliers.

text: 四十岁之后，如果人的基本面很差想逆风翻盘，你想折腾想鱼跃龙门基本上都是有心无力了。
en: After forty, if someone's fundamentals are poor and they wish to turn the tide, any desire to struggle or leap through the dragon's gate is essentially having the heart but lacking the strength.

text: 人真值钱的时候，是25-35岁这黄金十年，或者说25-40岁之间，这段时间的积累就注定了你40岁之后的人生。
en: The time when a person is truly valuable is the golden decade between 25 and 35, or rather between 25 and 40; the accumulation during this period determines the life you lead after forty.

text: 在这之前，你赚到过钱，知道怎么赚钱，积累了多少认知和执行力，决定了你40岁之后是继续往上还是往下。
en: Before this, whether you have earned money, know how to make it, and how much understanding and execution you have built up decides whether you keep rising or fall after forty.

text: 一般情况下，年轻时混好的人会继续好，年轻时混的差会继续差，除了大跌进式的创业者外，大部分普通人不会大起大落。
en: Generally, those who got by well when young go on doing well, and those who did poorly go on doing poorly; apart from entrepreneurs who make dramatic leaps, most ordinary people will not see great rises and falls.

text: 很多人举例雷军任正非等都是40岁之后辉煌的，但是人家在40岁之前，也是辉煌人生好不好，只不过40岁之后是plus版本。
en: Many cite Jun Lei and Zhengfei Ren as examples of brilliance after forty, but they were already living brilliant lives before forty; it is just that after forty they became the plus version.

text: 所以说，朋友们，如果你处于25-35岁之间，你要知道你每一天的能量都是决定40岁以后人生的重要一天，你就会知道应该干什么了。
en: So, friends, if you are between 25 and 35, you should know that each day's energy is a significant day that decides your life after forty, and then you will know what you ought to do.

text: 中年危机，也称“灰色中年”。
en: The midlife crisis is also known as the 'grey middle age'.

text: 一般高发在39～50岁，还被称为“男人四十综合征”。
en: It commonly strikes between the ages of 39 and 50, and is also called the 'man-at-forty syndrome'.

text: 从广义上来讲，是指这个人生阶段可能经历的事业、健康、家庭婚姻等各种关卡和危机。
en: In a broad sense, it refers to the various hurdles and crises one may face at this stage of life, such as career, health, family and marriage.

text: 以何种姿势面对下半场人生，成了最重要的问题。
en: How to face the second half of life has become the most important question.

text: 如果不能调整好心态，或许就会处于一种非常迷茫的状态之中。
en: If one cannot adjust one's mindset, one may fall into a state of deep confusion.

text: 男人为什么有中年危机？
en: Why do men have a midlife crisis?

text: 有三个层面：
en: There are three levels:

text: 第一个层面：物质困境，人到中年不如狗。
en: The first level: material hardship — a middle-aged person is worse off than a dog.

text: 中兴高管欧阳新被离职后自杀。
en: Xin Ouyang, an executive at ZTE, took his own life after being made redundant.

text: 留下巨额房贷和孤苦无依的妻儿。
en: Leaving behind a huge mortgage and a wife and children with no one to depend on.

text: 博纳副总裁，疫情期间从高楼一跃而下。
en: The vice president of Bona jumped from a high building during the pandemic.

text: 正如张爱玲在《半生缘》里说：“人到中年的男人，时常会觉得孤独，因为他一睁开眼睛，周围都是要依靠他的人，却没有他可以依靠的人。
en: As Eileen Chang wrote in Half a Lifetime of Love: 'A middle-aged man often feels lonely, because the moment he opens his eyes, everyone around him depends on him, yet there is no one he can depend on.

text: 他们过着看似光鲜的生活背后是巨额的债务。
en: Behind the seemingly glamorous lives they lead lie enormous debts.

text: 房贷、车贷、生活开支、孩子学费，外加赡养老人，压在他们身上的岂止是三座大山？
en: Mortgage, car loan, living expenses, children's tuition, plus the care of elderly parents — what weighs upon them is more than merely three great mountains?

text: 关于中年危机，这是最简单的一层。
en: As for the midlife crisis, this is the simplest layer.

text: 第二个层面：人到中年，没有自我实现过的空虚感。
en: The second level: reaching middle age with a sense of emptiness from never having achieved self-realisation.

text: 有一天，我的一位朋友到访我家。
en: One day, a friend of mine came to visit my home.

text: 半夜聊天时，他被触动了，突然开始流泪。
en: While chatting late at night, he was moved and suddenly began to weep.

text: 这位朋友比我年长，他当时已进入中年了。
en: This friend was older than me, and he had already entered middle age at the time.

text: 表面上，他过得还不错，但他却总觉得心里发慌。
en: On the surface, he was getting along alright, yet he always felt a vague panic within.

text: 他深深地觉得自己这辈子好像没有做真正有意义的事，做的所有事都像是浮在水面上。
en: He felt deeply that he seemed never to have done anything truly meaningful in his life, and everything he did felt as if it were floating on the surface of the water.

text: 这半辈子虽然过上了还不错的中产阶级生活，可这种要命的空虚感，在紧紧折磨着他。
en: Although he had attained a fairly comfortable middle-class life over these past decades, this deadly sense of emptiness was tormenting him relentlessly.

text: 这个层面的中年危机也源于信仰精神危机，过去我们信赖并追求的东西不再有意义。
en: This level of the midlife crisis also stems from a crisis of faith and spirit; the things we once trusted and pursued no longer hold any meaning.

text: 现在，需要更大的情怀来容纳我们的人生目的。
en: Now, a broader vision is needed to contain the purpose of our lives.

text: 第三个层面：对雄性能力逐渐丧失的恐慌。
en: The third level: the fear of gradually losing one's masculine capacity.

text: 对自己的性能力缺失了自信也是男性危机感产生的原因之一。
en: Losing confidence in one's own sexual ability is also one of the reasons a man's sense of crisis arises.

text: 恐惧自己不再对年轻女性有吸引力，或者性活动中感觉有些力不从心，都会让曾经雄赳赳、气昂昂的男人产生自我感丧失。
en: The fear of no longer being attractive to younger women, or of feeling somewhat unable to perform during sex, can make a man who was once full of vigour and pride lose his sense of self.

text: 人到中年，午夜惊觉人生过半，却还没有酣畅淋漓地生活过。
en: Reaching middle age, waking at midnight to realise that half of life has passed, yet having never lived it to the full.

text: 又或者人到中年，只剩下苍白的婚姻、失落的事业、日益消退的发际线…
en: Or reaching middle age, left only with a pale marriage, a lost career, and a receding hairline…

text: 都是会让人惶恐焦虑的事情。
en: These are all things that fill one with dread and anxiety.

text: 但是如何重新认识自己则会让事情有两种不同的走向：
en: But how one comes to know oneself anew will send things in two different directions:

text: 1、有的人开始重新考量自己，选择合适的方式继续生活。
en: 1. Some begin to re-examine themselves and choose a suitable way to carry on living.

text: 这一点，俞敏洪想的通透。
en: On this point, Minhong Yu sees things with great clarity.

text: 大风大浪过后体面离场，现在又开始在火热的直播行业里稳步耕耘，没有因“高位坠落”而愤世嫉俗，而是继续做“终生创业者”踏实做事，半生归来还是《中国合伙人》电影里那个成冬青。
en: After weathering great storms and leaving with dignity, he has now begun to till steadily in the booming live-streaming industry, not growing cynical because of his 'fall from a high position', but instead continuing to work steadily as a 'lifelong entrepreneur'; returning after half a lifetime, he is still Dongqing Cheng from the film American Dreams in China.

text: 处理中年危机最关键的是处理心态问题。
en: The key to handling a midlife crisis is handling the mindset.

text: 而不是给自己打鸡血，把自己逼到崩溃的边缘。
en: Rather than giving yourself a shot of chicken blood and driving yourself to the brink of collapse.

text: 2、而有的人可能会去寻求新的理想，亦或者说一种刺激。
en: 2. While others may go in search of a new ideal, or rather, a kind of stimulation.

text: 李安导演拍《色戒》后，在香港亚洲电影节采访中承认自己是“中年危机加少年反叛”。
en: After directing Lust, Caution, director Ang Lee admitted in an interview at the Hong Kong Asian Film Festival that he was a 'midlife crisis plus adolescent rebellion'.

text: 其实，这部电影中浓烈的荷尔蒙味道、性的压抑与暴发，则是中年危机中男人的集体渴望。
en: In fact, the intense hormonal flavour, the repression and eruption of sexuality in this film, represent the collective longing of men in the throes of a midlife crisis.

text: 这是更高级的处理中年欲望的方式。
en: This is a more sophisticated way of handling middle-aged desire.

text: 当然，最常见的就是寻找外遇，而且会去找比自己年轻很多的姑娘。
en: Of course, the most common is to seek an affair, and they will look for much younger girls.

text: 去感觉年轻时候不顾一切的爱恋。
en: To feel once more the reckless love of youth.

text: 而《月亮与六便士》里的思特里克兰德似乎就是第二种，我们也可以把绘画理解为外遇。
en: And Strickland in The Moon and Sixpence seems to be the second type; we can also understand painting as an affair.

text: 因为，这类型的中年男人在多年的重复式生活之后，会非常渴望一种“被打动”的感觉。
en: Because this type of middle-aged man, after years of repetitive living, will deeply crave a feeling of being 'moved'.

text: 在他们开始对一切变得漠然的时候，“心动”为他们提供了一个情感的出口。
en: When they begin to grow indifferent to everything, 'a stirring of the heart' provides them with an emotional outlet.

text: 当男人的中年危机，我们需要怎么办？
en: When a man is in the midst of a midlife crisis, what should we do?

text: 度过中年危机，其实不仅仅是一个人的事情，更是一个家庭的事情。
en: Getting through a midlife crisis is in fact not just one person's affair, but a family's affair.

text: 前段时间跳楼自杀的中兴员工欧某。
en: A ZTE employee surnamed Ou who recently jumped to his death.

text: 他的妻子没有工作，在家当家庭主妇。
en: His wife did not work and stayed at home as a housewife.

text: 两个年幼的孩子嗷嗷待哺。
en: Two young children cried out to be fed.

text: 双方四个老人，每月要还的车贷、房贷等等。
en: Four elderly parents on both sides, plus the monthly car loan, mortgage and such to be repaid.

text: 当42岁的他，被通知裁员的时候。
en: When the 42-year-old was notified of his redundancy.

text: 所有的压力犹如一股无情的洪流，直冲头顶。
en: All the pressure was like a merciless torrent rushing straight to the top of his head.

text: 一家老小的生活，全都压在自己身上，
en: The livelihood of the whole family, old and young, all pressed upon his own shoulders,

text: 不敢说，不好说，不愿说，最后一了百了。
en: Dare not speak, cannot easily speak, will not speak, and in the end he ends it all.

text: 中年男人的危急，也需要伴侣来理解和支持：
en: The crisis facing a middle-aged man also calls for understanding and support from a partner:

text: 第一，女人独立起来，家庭开源节流，男人压力便少了。
en: First, when women become independent and the family opens up sources of income while cutting expenditure, the man's pressure eases.

text: 知乎上有一个高赞回答说得好：“真正解决中年危机，靠的是家庭，靠的是媳妇的收入和支持，是父母的养老储备和义务劳动，是孩子的成长和回馈，是家庭的理解和包容。
en: On Zhihu there is a highly upvoted answer that puts it well: 'To truly resolve a midlife crisis, one relies on the family, on the wife's income and support, on the parents' retirement savings and voluntary labour, on the child's growth and repayment, and on the family's understanding and tolerance.

text: 和技术一毛钱关系都没有。
en: It has nothing to do with technology whatsoever.

text: 当女人独立起来，出去工作，多一份收入，尽力理解男人在职业发展中的困境。
en: When women become independent, go out to work, earn an extra income, and do their utmost to understand the difficulties men face in their careers,

text: 男人则会有完全不同的心理状态。
en: men will have a completely different state of mind.

text: 第二、给他一个自我缓冲的空间。
en: Second, give him a space to buffer himself.

text: 曾有江湖传闻：爱钓鱼的男人从不出轨。
en: There is a saying in the jianghu: men who love fishing never stray.

text: 拿起鱼竿不是为了逃避家庭，而是在接受自己。
en: Picking up a fishing rod is not to escape the family, but to accept oneself.

text: 中年男人的战场越来越窄，所以他们需要更多的空间来获得自我平衡。
en: The battlefield of a middle-aged man grows ever narrower, so they need more space to regain their self-balance.

text: 就比如，你在每一个篮球场都能见到几个中年装备党。
en: For instance, at every basketball court you can see a few middle-aged gear enthusiasts.

text: 而且相关研究表明，45岁后的夫妻，在步入中年后会有相反的变化，正常的情况是，女性变得更加男性思维化，而男人则变得更加柔软，更加需要示弱。
en: Moreover, relevant research shows that couples after 45, once they enter middle age, undergo opposite changes; normally, women become more masculine in their thinking, while men become softer and more inclined to show weakness.

text: 也就是说，中年是一个需要把男人变软的时刻。
en: That is to say, middle age is a time that requires men to soften.

text: 这个软不仅是心理上的和性欲上的，也是价值观，现实感，对错，进取心。
en: This softening is not only psychological and sexual, but also in values, sense of reality, right and wrong, and drive.

text: 而女人给予的空间则非常重要。
en: And the space that women give is extremely important.

text: 第三、鼓励他突破精神和自我实现上的困境。
en: Third, encourage him to break through his difficulties in spirit and self-realisation.

text: 曾经刷爆探险界的70后山东兖州人翟峰，从17岁开始任职铁路信号工。
en: Zhai Feng, a post-70s man from Yanzhou, Shandong, who once took the adventure world by storm, began working as a railway signalman at the age of 17.

text: 2018年体制工作后，他依旧忘不了他的航海梦。
en: After leaving his post in the state system in 2018, he still could not forget his sailing dream.

text: 他却从最初的叛逆少年，变成巨大机器上的一枚螺丝钉。
en: Yet he went from a rebellious youth at first to a single screw on a giant machine.

text: 这一眼看到尽头的人生，让他深深惧怕。
en: This life, with its end visible at a glance, filled him with deep fear.

text: 妻子看懂了他的无奈和渴望，也支持他三十多年来的航海梦。
en: His wife understood his helplessness and longing, and supported his sailing dream of more than thirty years.

text: 选择举家辞职休学，在2012年底带着妻子和8岁女儿、卖房卖车所得39万。
en: Choosing to resign and take the whole family out of school, at the end of 2012 he set off with his wife and eight-year-old daughter, and 390,000 yuan from selling their house and car.

text: 成为中国首个航海家庭。
en: Becoming China's first sailing family.

text: 因为他的妻子很明白，如果他能够饱满地体验的去体验生命，能够完成儿时的梦想就会很大程度减轻空虚感。
en: Because his wife understood clearly that if he could experience life to the full, fulfilling his childhood dream would greatly lessen his sense of emptiness.

text: 所以她选择了无条件支持。
en: So she chose unconditional support.

text: 真实美好的婚姻，历来都是需求夫妻一起进步和一起生长的。
en: A truly good marriage has always required husband and wife to progress and grow together.

text: 两个人婚姻的质量是以落后的那个为基准，而不是以优异的那个。
en: The quality of a couple's marriage is measured by the lagging one, not the excellent one.

text: 所以，当其中一方有什么难题了，另外一个人必定要自动去拉对方一把。
en: Therefore, when one side encounters a difficulty, the other must step in to lend a hand and pull them up.

text: 天下女子或是男子若求的只是一个玩伴，一个恋人，那尽管敷衍。
en: If women or men under heaven seek only a playmate or a lover, they may simply go through the motions.

text: 可婚姻婚姻不是一见钟情、门当户对就可以天长地久的事情。
en: But marriage — marriage is not something that lasts forever merely because of love at first sight and a good match in social standing.

text: 陪伴对方走过生活中的千回百转，一起面对中途那般多的枝枝蔓蔓，处理不同阶段的不同难题，是永远无法逃避的事情。
en: Accompanying one another through life's countless twists and turns, facing together the many branches and entanglements along the way, and dealing with the different difficulties of different stages, is something one can never escape.

text: 无论是遇到男人的危机，还是女人的危机。
en: Whether it is a man's crisis or a woman's crisis.

text: 两人一同披荆斩棘与披星戴月的决心，必定是度过人生中任何危机的解药。
en: The determination of two people to cut through thorns and brave the stars and moon together is surely the antidote to any crisis in life.
